title: Engram identity slice 2: surface installed vs serving identity and staleness in state, Settings, session status, CLI and the context nudge
outcome: Slice 2: make the identity triple and any mismatch visible where someone can act. State: a host-level Engram runtime summary (installed identity, number of sessions launched with an older identity) and per session engram.runtimeIdentity {installed, controlLaunchedWith, mcpLaunchedWith, lastContextObserved, stale}. UI: Settings > Engram host status shows installed build and the stale-session count with a refresh control (slice 3); the session shows one compact status line when stale (for example: Engram MCP child launched with build f234d5b2, installed 65b2b11c, refresh available). CLI: the sessions listing carries the stale flag and both short fingerprints. Agent-facing: one line appended to the next Engram context nudge for a stale session (installed vs launched-with, and how to request refresh) - never added to mailbox wakes, which stay metadata-only. Acceptance: the Phoenix case (installed 65b2b11c vs MCP launched with f234d5b2) renders in all three surfaces from a fixture; a fresh session shows nothing extra; tests pin the state shape and the nudge line.
